title: Dolan's early appearances and Stanton Friedman pressing him on Bob Lazar

tellings.quote: Um so, I mean, I'm there and Stan like I'm sitting alone with him and he's checking me out. He's like, "Who is this guy?" Because I just written a a book, big fat book, and uh he's like, "So, what's your opinion on Bob Lazar?"

plain: Richard Dolan, an author who had just published a big book on UFOs, says that around 2001, at early events in Laughlin, Nevada and St. Louis, Missouri, he found himself alone with Stanton Friedman, a well-known UFO researcher. Dolan says Friedman was sizing him up and asked his opinion of Bob Lazar, a much-debated figure in UFO circles. He tells it on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2025.
